programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel reproaches Camila for wanting to elope with her son Max, she denies it. But he no longer believes her and doubts whether or not he should help her. Camila reacts and demands that he keep his word. Max's condition is stable but delicate. Camila goes to the hospital where Astrid tries to attack her.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel agrees to help her in exchange for theirs being a real marriage and having a child. Camila executes her plans without his help and leaves. Rosa Blanco told Mother Isabel the whole truth. Disappointed with her daughter's marriage to one of her worst enemies.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila, who has taken Chantal to live in the Mansion. Marcelina tells her that her son has decided to marry Astrid. Sebastián interrupts Julia and Gregorio's ceremony. Torrealba arrests Antón. Rosa Blanco returns and Fausto asks Fernando to finish her off.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila learns of Rosa Blanco's death. Everyone gives her their condolences and Max calls her to offer his support. Luciano, who was the one who brought the news of the death. Sebastián fails to prevent Julia and Gregorio's marriage. Leandro defends his relationship with Jeli.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Rosa deceived everyone: she is not dead. Camila does not know this and continues to be devastated and ratifies her hatred and rage against those who contributed to her mother's death. Astrid, happy for the wedding.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Octavia helps Astrid in the preparation of the marriage and enjoys thinking about how Camila feels. Camila and Max, very hurt, know that they must forget each other. Fausto, insists that Roger and Fernando plan Ezequiel's death.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Marcelina, family members and the judge worry about Max's absence. Astrid accuses Camila of agreeing to give her a hard time. The groom arrives, drunk and helped by Ezequiel. They sign their wedding vows. Months later, Astrid, stressed, wants a child to secure her fortune. Ezequiel, without results, wants to make Camila fall in love.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Anton takes Ezequiel kidnapped and warns Fausto, so that he can have the pleasure of killing him. Under deception they summon Amelia and Sebastian to make Fausto reason with them to free Ezequiel, otherwise she and her unborn child will die.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Total chaos in the church after the shooting. Max is wounded. Ezequiel, takes her by the arm and leads her away, although he feels sorry for his son. Fausto and Roger are the protagonists of this thwarted murder. Ezequiel and Camila tell each other harsh truths.
